tbesh_html:
Combined with e.meq (עֵ֫מֶק " Valley" H6010M)
§ Jezreel = "God sows"
a city in Issachar on the northwest spur of Mount Gilboa

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Jizreel, the name of two places in Palestine and of two Israelites
strongs_1890.derivation: from H2232 (זָרַע) and H410 (אֵל); God will sow;
